Dear Mr Gallagher,

Please find our client's Defence served by CE-file today. We maintain the denials and the clause 11 limitation. We remain open to a commercial discussion if your client wishes to make a realistic proposal.

messages.subject: FW: Ashfield v Marwick - Defence served
messages.plaintextBody:
Elena - Defence in. Nothing surprising; they plead misalignment/overloading/maintenance and clause 11, and they take a betterment point on the Renforth replacements and say the £95k Halcyon LDs are too remote. Please diarise directions and start prepping Paul's statement. We'll want Renshaw's report finalised before the CMC.

Tom

Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ | www.whitfieldcarter.com
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
